title: AgentHandoff
description: Structured handoff record returned by any specialist agent to the Controller after completing or stopping on a bounded task.

task_id.description: Unique identifier for the bounded task this handoff covers.

owner_agent.description: ID of the agent that performed the work.

scope.description: The bounded work assigned to this agent and the plan/spec version it relates to.

approved_plan_version.description: Identifier or description of the approved plan version governing this task, if applicable.

code_identity.description: Repository state when this handoff was produced.

work_performed.description: Narrative summary of what was done in this task.

files_changed.description: Relative paths of files created, modified, or deleted during this task.

acceptance_criteria_results.description: Per-criterion result mapping requirement to evidence, status, and any unmet reason.

verification_evidence.description: Records of checks, tests, or inspections performed.

findings.description: Finding IDs produced or referenced in this handoff. Full records are in the finding registry.

assumptions.description: Assumptions made during this task that have not been verified or approved.

risks.description: Residual risks or open concerns the Controller should be aware of.

approval_needed.description: Description of any approval gate that must be satisfied before this work can proceed.

next_action.description: Recommended next step for the Controller.

produced_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this handoff record was produced.
